name: UWA SOS Emergency Grant
summary: Non-repayable UWA grant for onshore students at risk of discontinuing because of exceptional, unforeseen hardship.
who: Enrolled onshore and at risk of discontinuing
Exceptional and unforeseen circumstances causing hardship
Must have tried other help, such as Centrelink or Guild support
catches: Only for unexpected costs; cannot pay tuition fees

evidence.quote: does not have to be paid back.
